name: James Hardie Industries
outlook:
What James Hardie Industries says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: net sales, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flowWe are reaffirming our consolidated full-year fiscal 2027 net sales and Adjusted EBITDA guidance and increasing our free cash flow target to more than $650 million. We expect Adjusted EBITDA to be lower in the third quarter and second half driven by DR&A seasonality in Q3, incremental freight costs and the weaker macro environment.
  • Fiscal 2027: capital expendituresFor FY2027, we continue to expect capital expenditures to be in the range of approximately 6% to 7% of net sales, reflecting maintenance and targeted growth investments across the manufacturing network.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
